concept.title: generations
concept.shortdesc: Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) are accelerators for machine learning. This set documents four generations, which share most concepts and tasks but differ in their values.

data.name: licence
data.value: CC BY 4.0. Adapted from the source page and modified: restructured as DITA, values moved to keys.

conbody.p: Each generation has an introduction, a specifications topic, a configurations topic and a VM types topic. Values such as chips per pod are stored once as keys, so a corrected value changes every page that shows it.
